name: seecode
description: Animated, explorable editorial diagrams in 42 types — architecture, flowchart, sequence, state, ER, DB schema, UML, swimlane, timeline, Gantt, journey, tree, Venn, quadrant, fishbone, Wardley, bar, line, scatter, Sankey, treemap, heatmap and more — from a short JSON spec. Hover traces, click-to-focus, route journeys; exports SVG, PNG, GIF, MP4; imports Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML, D2, draw.io, Excalidraw, SQL and CSV.
